en.title: The Teahouse of Early Summer Rain and the Coolness of Ice
en.premise: In a quiet corner of Edo, the residents of the tenement houses are as lively as ever. Seijūji, a carver of great skill but clumsy nature, discovers a mysterious teahouse that appears at the end of an alley only when it rains. There, accompanied by the rhythmic sound of falling rain, he is served rare teas and sweets that evoke the shifting seasons. Following a stir surrounding the 'Ice Castle'—an ice carving admired by all during the summer festival—Seijūji and his neighbors discover the serenity of rainy days and the warmth of human connection.

zh.title: 五月雨的茶屋与冰雕之凉
zh.premise: 在江户的一隅，长屋的居民们今天也依旧热闹非凡。技艺精湛却性格笨拙的雕刻师清次，偶然发现了一家只在雨天才会出现在小巷尽头的神秘茶屋。在那里，伴随着阵阵雨声，有能让人感受到季节更迭的珍稀点心与清茶。经历了一场围绕着夏日祭典上众人向往的冰雕“冰之城”而引发的骚动，清次与长屋的邻人们一起，在雨天的静谧中，寻得了人们之间温暖的羁绊。
